SUBJECT: Arbitration Court for Central European
Refugees

Up to the present, i.e. April 1, 1942, there
have been two Arbitration Courts for Central European
Refugees functioning in the area north of the Soochow
creek. One was originally sponsored by the "Internati-
onal Committee for the Organization of European Immigr-
ants in China", and was established late in 1939 at the
Alcock Road Refugee Camp, 68 Alcock Road. The other
was established in February 1942 by the "Juedische
Gemeinde" and the circumstances leading to its establish-
ment are described in Special Branch File No. D.5422 C-12.

With the closure of the "I.C." , the "Committee
for the Assistance of European Refugees in Shanghai"
took charge of the Arbitration Court at Alcock Road.
In view of the fact that the committee is now faced
with the problem of collecting funds to keep some 6000
persons from starvation (see report submitted by this
section on March 19, 1942.), it is manifest that all its
time and energy is taken up by this work which is of
more vital importance. The "Committee for the Assistance
of European Refugees in Shanghai" has decided, therefore,
to close its Conciliation Board at Alcock Road, and has
handed over all pending cases to the Arbitration Court
of the Juedische Gemeinde located at 416/22 Tongshan
Road.

The Arbitration Court of the Juedische Gemeinde
is administrated by the following four lawyer, who are
members and active workers of the said community,

主题：中欧难民仲裁庭

截至本日，即1942年4月1日，在苏州河以北地区有两个中欧难民仲裁庭在运作。其中一个最初由“在华欧洲移民组织国际委员会”赞助，于1939年底在阿尔科路（Alcock Road）68号阿尔科路难民营成立。另一个由“犹太公会”（Juedische Gemeinde）于1942年2月成立，其成立背景详见特务科档案号 D.5422 C-12。

随着“国际委员会”（I.C.）的关闭，“上海欧洲难民援助委员会”接管了阿尔科路的仲裁庭。鉴于该委员会目前面临着筹集资金以防止约6000人挨饿的问题（参见本部门于1942年3月19日提交的报告），显然其所有时间和精力都投入到了这项更为至关重要的工作中。因此，“上海欧洲难民援助委员会”决定关闭其在阿尔科路的调解委员会，并将所有未决案件移交给位于同山路416/22号的犹太公会仲裁庭。

RULES REGULATING ARBITRATION
IN DISPUTES OF EUROPEAN JEWISH EMIGRANTS

ARTICLE 1. The Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai (hereinafter to be designated as COMMITTEE) expects all emigrants to submit their legal disputes to arbitration before taking up proceedings before the competent authorities.
To deal with such cases, the COMMITTEE has organised the "Arbitration Board for European Emigrants" (hereinafter to be referred to as "BOARD").

ARTICLE 2. The Board, organised under the present rules, is created for the purpose of handling all disputes which cannot be settled amicably, or are not of a nature that, in accordance with the prevailing laws in Shanghai, can be decided only by the competent authorities, provided both parties to the dispute are emigrants.

ARTICLE 3. The Board may refuse to accept to handle certain cases without stating reasons to the parties.

ARTICLE 4. The Board consist of a Chairman, a certain number of umpires and arbitrators, and an adequate permanent staff for conducting its current affairs.

ARTICLE 5. The Chairman of the Board ist the Legal Adviser to the Committee. He has to supervise the organisation and functions of the Board and, in particular, to draft and amend the rules regulating procedure before the Board and detailed regulations in connection thereof, to conclude employment contracts with the auxiliary organs of the Board and, finally to keep the lists of umpires and arbitrators always up to date.

ARTICLE 6. The umpires and arbitrators will act on an honorary basis without any financial or other remuneration. One umpire and two arbitrators have to act in all individual cases to decide the dispute in the spirit of the present regulations. Lists will be drawn up for the umpires and arbitrators respectively.
Parties applying for or submitting to arbitration, as well as arbitrators electing the umpires, may elect their arbitrators and umpires respectively only from among persons figuring on the said lists, to the total exclusion of all outsiders. The Chairman will be competent to decide the qualification to be considered for the insertion in the lists of umpires and arbitrators respectively.
The Chairman, umpires and arbitrators cannot exercise any activity with regard to advising or representing emigrants in connection with cases to be submitted to the Board.

ARTICLE 7. The permanent organ of the Board will be the permanent secretary, who will conduct the current affairs of the Board, the meetings of the parties in view of an amicable settlement in the spirit of Art. 9 and prepare the hearings where he will conduct proper minutes. He is not allowed to exercise any legal practice.

ARTICLE 8. The Board, while observing the laws prevailing in Shanghai, may apply such law as it may be presumed to have been the intention of the parties to apply at the time the act-in-the-law or transaction out of which the dispute arises, was respectively done or concluded. Should it prove impossible to ascertain such law, or should same be inapplicable in Shanghai, then and in such case the dispute is to be settled in accordance with Chinese law, and or prevailing local custom.

ARTICLE 9. A party desirous of referring a case to arbitration shall arrange first that as well as the adverse party should appear before the Board for conciliation. Should the attempt of conciliation prove futile, then in such case, provided the dispute is of certain amount of money or value which can be expressed in money, proper proceedings of arbitration will be taken up in the spirit of the present rules; in other cases the procedure to be followed should be left at the discretion of the parties themselves.

ARTICLE 10. Plaintiff, in referring the case to arbitration in the spirit of the present rules shall address a petition in duplicate to such effect to the Board, briefly explaining his or her case, and at the same time nominating his or her arbitrator, indicating his or her proofs and containing a short prayer. The consent of the arbitrator nominated in the petition in written form shall be attached to the petition.

ARTICLE 11. One copy of the Plaintiff's petition is to be served to the adverse party within three (3) days from date of receipt thereof by the Board. The Defendant is to give a written answer to such petition within eight (8) clear days from the date of service of the same, giving a short description of his defense, indicating his proofs and nominating his arbitrator, whose consent to act is to be attached to the answer in written form.

ARTICLE 12. Should the circumstances so require, the Board may order the parties to prepare and file further briefs for the explanation of their respective cases before a date for the hearing is to be set.

ARTICLE 13. After the petition and answer of the parties have been duly filed, the arbitrators shall jointly elect an umpire who will conduct the hearings, and shall have a decisive vote for the decision to be passed in the event of the arbitrators' failure to agree.
Should the arbitrators for three (3) days as from date of filing of the last documents by the parties fail to come to an understanding as to the person of the umpire to be jointly elected by them, such umpire shall be appointed by the Chairman of the Board.

ARTICLE 14. The Umpire, after having been duly elected or nominated, will set a date for the hearing, possibly within eight (8) days from the date of his appointment. The parties are to be summoned in writing to appear at the hearing and to produce all evidence available and referred to by them in connection with their case.

欧洲犹太移民争议仲裁规则

第一条. 上海欧洲犹太难民援助委员会（以下简称“委员会”）期望所有移民在向主管当局提起诉讼之前，将其法律纠纷提交仲裁。为处理此类案件，委员会组织了“欧洲移民仲裁委员会”（以下简称“委员会”或“仲裁庭”）。

第二条. 根据本规则组织的仲裁庭，旨在处理所有无法友好解决、或根据其性质依照上海现行法律只能由主管当局裁决、且争议双方均为移民的纠纷。

第三条. 仲裁庭可以拒绝受理某些案件，且无需向当事人说明理由。

第四条. 仲裁庭由一名主席、若干名公断人和仲裁员，以及负责处理日常事务的适当常设工作人员组成。

第五条. 仲裁庭主席是委员会的法律顾问。他必须监督仲裁庭的组织和工作职能，特别是起草和修订规范仲裁庭程序的规则及相关细则，与仲裁庭的辅助机构签订雇佣合同，并最终保持公断人和仲裁员名单的最新状态。

第六条. 公断人和仲裁员将以荣誉方式行事，不收取任何金钱或其他报酬。在所有个别案件中，须由一名公断人和两名仲裁员共同行动，本着本规则的精神裁决纠纷。将分别为公断人和仲裁员编制名单。
申请或提交仲裁的当事人，以及选举公断人的仲裁员，只能从上述名单所列人员中分别选举其仲裁员和公断人，完全排除名单以外的人员。主席有权决定列入公断人和仲裁员名单所需的资格。
主席、公断人和仲裁员不得就提交给仲裁庭的案件提供咨询或代表移民进行任何活动。

第七条. 仲裁庭的常设机构为常任秘书，他将处理仲裁庭的日常事务，按照第九条的精神主持各方会议以寻求友好解决，并准备听证会，在会上制作适当的笔录。他不得从事任何法律执业活动。

第八条. 仲裁庭在遵守上海现行法律的同时，可适用推定为当事人在产生纠纷的法律行为或交易发生或达成时意图适用的法律。如果证明无法查明该法律，或者该法律在上海不适用，则在此情况下，纠纷应根据中国法律和/或当地 prevailing 习俗解决。

第九条. 希望将案件提交仲裁的一方，应首先安排对方当事人出庭接受调解。如果调解尝试证明无效，那么在这种情况下，只要纠纷涉及一定金额或可用金钱表示的价值，将按照本规则的精神进行适当的仲裁程序；在其他情况下，应遵循的程序由当事人自行酌情决定。

第十条. 原告本着本规则的精神将案件提交仲裁时，应向仲裁庭提交一式两份的申请书，简要说明其案情，同时提名其仲裁员，列明其证据，并提出简短的请求。申请书中提名的仲裁员的书面同意书应附在申请书后。

第十一条. 原告申请书的一份副本应在仲裁庭收到之日起三（3）天内送达对方当事人。被告应在送达之日起八（8）个整日内对该申请书作出书面答复，简要描述其辩护理由，列明其证据，并提名其仲裁员，其担任仲裁员的书面同意书应附在答复后。

第十二条. 如果情况需要，仲裁庭可以命令双方在确定听证日期之前，准备并提交进一步的简报，以解释各自的案情。

第十三条. 在当事人的申请书和答辩状正式提交后，仲裁员应共同选举一名公断人，他将主持听证会，并在仲裁员未能达成一致意见时，对所作决定拥有决定性的一票。
如果自当事人提交最后文件之日起三（3）天内，仲裁员未能就共同选举的公断人人选达成共识，则该公断人应由仲裁庭主席任命。

第十四条. 公断人经正式选举或提名后，将确定听证日期，可能在其任命之日起八（8）天内。应以书面形式传唤当事人出席听证会，并提交与其案件有关的所有可用证据及所提及的证据。

ARTICLE 15. Once elected, arbitrators and umpires must attend the case from the beginning to conclusion. If for some grounds an arbitrator and/or umpire is compelled to suspend his activity and is replaced by a substitute, the entire procedure, if already begun, shall be resumed and recapitulated.

ARTICLE 16. Arbitrators and Umpires shall be deemed to be barred from acting in such capacity by the same reasons, mutatis mutandis, as, according to the Chinese Code of Civil Procedure, entitle parties to demand the withdrawal of a judge.

ARTICLE 17. Proceedings before the Board shall, as a rule, be verbal and contradictory.

ARTICLE 18. The Umpire, before opening the hearing, shall see to it that both parties sign a submission, in a form accepted as valid by Chinese law, accepting in advance as final and binding whatever decision may be rendered by the Board herein.

ARTICLE 19. The parties appearing before the Board shall, as a rule, handle their case personally. It will be however, at the discretion of the Board to allow them to be represented by duly qualified attorneys.

ARTICLE 20. As a rule, proceedings before the Board herein entail no costs for the parties, except in cases where the nature of the dispute or the value involved would afford the Board sufficient reason to charge costs, the latter would be accounted for in accordance with local custom.
The same principle will be applied as for the conciliation proceedings herein—above.

ARTICLE 21. Accurate minutes shall be kept of all proceedings. Original exhibits, if any, shall be handed back to the parties upon termination of the proceedings.
The final award of the Arbitration Board shall always be made in writing, exposing the reasons for the decisions taken.

ARTICLE 22. It shall be the care of the winning party to see to it that the award is duly executed.

ARTICLE 23. The present rules will be published in English and German languages. In case of discrepancy, the English text will be deemed to be authentic.
The English and German texts of the present rules, as well as the lists of the Umpires and Arbitrators, should be always available for the parties and other interested persons in the premises of the Board. All other and further publications, if any, concerning the Board, should be available at the same place.

ARITCLE 24. The present rules will enter into effect on March 10. 1940, on which date rules and regulations enforced before will cease to be valid. Cases filed prior to that date will be handled in accordance with the present rules, unless already decided by an award.

第十五条. 一旦当选，仲裁员和公断人必须从头到尾参与案件处理。如果因某种原因仲裁员和/或公断人被迫中止其活动并由替补人员接替，如果程序已经开始，则应重新开始并重述整个程序。

第十六条. 仲裁员和公断员不得以此身份行事的原因，比照《中国民事诉讼法》中允许当事人要求法官回避的相同理由，作必要变更后适用。

第十七条. 仲裁庭的程序通常为口头和对质式的。

第十八条. 公断人在开庭前，应确保双方签署一份符合中国法律认可的有效格式的提交书，预先接受仲裁庭在此作出的任何决定为最终且具有约束力。

第十九条. 出庭参加仲裁庭程序的当事人，通常应亲自处理其案件。但是，仲裁庭有权酌情允许他们由具备适当资格的律师代理。

第二十条. 通常情况下，在仲裁庭进行的程序不涉及当事人的费用，除非纠纷的性质或涉及的金额使仲裁庭有充分理由收取费用，后者将根据当地习俗核算。
同样的原则也适用于上述调解程序。

第二十一条. 所有程序均应保存准确的笔录。原始证物（如有）应在程序终止时退还给当事人。
仲裁庭的最终裁决书始终应以书面形式作出，并阐明作出决定的理由。

第二十二条. 胜诉方有责任确保裁决得到 duly 执行。

第二十三条. 本规则将以英文和德文出版。如有出入，以英文文本为准。
本规则的英文和德文文本，以及公断人和仲裁员名单，应随时在仲裁庭办公场所供当事人和其他利害关系人查阅。关于仲裁庭的所有其他及进一步出版物（如有），也应在同一地点提供。

第二十四条. 本规则将于1940年3月10日生效，此前执行的规则和条例同日失效。在该日期之前提交的案件将按照本规则处理，除非已由裁决作出决定。

ARTICLE 15. Once elected, arbitrators and umpires must attend the case from the beginning to conclusion. If for some grounds an arbitrator and/or umpire is compelled to suspend his activity and is replaced by a substitute, the entire procedure, if already begun, shall be resumed and recapitulated.

ARTICLE 16. Arbitrators and Umpires shall be deemed to be barred from acting in such capacity by the same reasons, mutatis mutandis, as, according to the Chinese Code of Civil Procedure, entitle parties to demand the withdrawal of a judge.

ARTICLE 17. Proceedings before the Board shall, as a rule, be verbal and contradictory.

ARTICLE 18. The Umpire, before opening the hearing, shall see to it that both parties sign a submission, in a form accepted as valid by Chinese law, accepting in advance as final and binding whatever decision may be rendered by the Board herein.

ARTICLE 19. The parties appearing before the Board shall, as a rule, handle their case personally. It will be however, at the discretion of the Board to allow them to be represented by duly qualified attorneys.

ARTICLE 20. As a rule, proceedings before the Board herein entail no costs for the parties, except in cases where the nature of the dispute or the value involved would afford the Board sufficient reason to charge costs, the latter would be accounted for in accordance with local custom.
The same principle will be applied as for the conciliation proceedings herein—above.

ARTICLE 21. Accurate minutes shall be kept of all proceedings. Original exhibits, if any, shall be handed back to the parties upon termination of the proceedings.
The final award of the Arbitration Board shall always be made in writing, exposing the reasons for the decisions taken.

ARTICLE 22. It shall be the care of the winning party to see to it that the award is duly executed.

ARTICLE 23. The present rules will be published in English and German languages. In case of discrepancy, the English text will be deemed to be authentic.
The English and German texts of the present rules, as well as the lists of the Umpires and Arbitrators, should be always available for the parties and other interested persons in the premises of the Board. All other and further publications, if any, concerning the Board, should be available at the same place.

ARTICLE 24. The present rules will enter into effect on March 10. 1940, on which date rules and regulations enforced before will cease to be valid. Cases filed prior to that date will be handled in accordance with the present rules, unless already decided by an award.

第十八条. 公断人在开启听证会之前，应确保双方签署一份提交书，该提交书的形式需为中国法律所认可有效，预先接受仲裁庭在此作出的任何决定为最终且具有约束力。

第十九条. 出席仲裁庭的当事人原则上应亲自处理其案件。然而，仲裁庭有权酌情允许他们由具备适当资格的律师代理。

第二十条. 原则上，在仲裁庭进行的程序不向当事人收取任何费用，除非争议的性质或涉及的价值使仲裁庭有充分理由收取费用，后者将根据当地惯例进行核算。
同一原则也适用于上述调解程序。

第二十一条. 所有程序均应保存准确的笔录。原始证物（如有）应在程序终止时退还给当事人。

第二十二条. 胜诉方有责任确保裁决得到 duly executed（妥善执行）。

第二十三条. 本规章将以英文和德文出版。如有出入，以英文文本为准。
本规章的英文和德文文本，以及公断人和仲裁员名单，应随时在仲裁庭办公场所供当事人和其他利害关系人查阅。所有其他有关仲裁庭的出版物（如有），也应在同一地点提供。

第二十四条. 本规章将于1940年3月10日生效，此前施行的规章和条例同日失效。在该日期之前提交的案件，除非已有裁决结案，否则将按照本规章处理。

Sehr geehrter Herr Kollege,

Ihre beiden Schreiben vom 7.cr. sind heute frueh ein-
gegangen. Zu meinem Bedauern sehe ich mich aus den nachstehend
aufgefuehrten Gruenden nicht in der Lage, Ihrer Einladung
Folge zu leisten.

.) Ich habe eine seit langem festliegende anderweitige
Verpflichtung der der vorgeschlagenen Zeit,

<.) Ich habe keine Vollmacht, fuer die 19 Herren, die ihr
Einverstaendnis mit dem ihren Auftraggebern zugegan-
genen Dokument erklaert haben, zu verhandeln.

3.) Solche Vollmacht haben nur Herr Ledien und ich gemein-
sam, und Herr Ledien ist zu seinem und meinem Erstaunen
nicht zu der vorgeschlagenen Besprechung eingeladen
worden.

4.) Die Frage Ihrer eigenen Vollmachten und Ihrer Funktion
in dieser Sache muesste vorab geklaert werden. Treten
Sie fuer Ihre Auftraggeber als Anwalt oder als Mitglied
des neu konstituierten Schiedsgerichtes auf? Aus Ihrem
Schreiben wird das nicht ersichtlich. Haben Sie Voll-
machten, die etwa als noetig erkannten Aenderungen an
der Schiedsgerichtsordnung selbst vorzunehmen? Eine
unverbindliche Diskussion waere fuer uns ohne Interesse.

5.) Wenn Sie mich sehen wollen, so scheint es mir das
Gegebene, dass Sie zu meinem Buero kommen und nicht
umgekehrt.

6.) Der Ton des einen Ihrer Schreiben gibt der Vermutung
Raum, dass Sie einer sachlichen Besprechung der An-
gelegenheit wenig geneigt sind.

7.) Es befremdet uns, dass die Herren Hayim, Spiegelman,
Kelen und Kann es nicht fuer noetig halten, sich fuer
unsere Vorstellungen zu interessieren und sich offenbar
weigern, ueber eine von ihnen als Mitglieder des Ober-
committee doch wohl gutgeheissene ausserordentlich ein-
schneidende Massnahme ueberhaupt in Eroerterungen ein-
zutreten.

尊敬的同事先生：

您本月7日的两封信已于今早收悉。令我遗憾的是，鉴于下述原因，我无法接受您的邀请。

1.) 我在提议的时间段内有一项早已确定的其他义务，

2.) 我没有授权代表那19位已声明同意向其委托人发出的文件的先生们进行谈判。

3.) 只有 Ledien 先生和我共同拥有此类授权，而令我和他都感到惊讶的是，Ledien 先生并未受邀参加提议的会谈。

4.) 您自身的授权范围以及您在此事中的职能必须事先澄清。您是作为律师还是作为新组成的仲裁庭的成员代表您的委托人？从您的信中看不出这一点。您是否有权对被认为必要的仲裁规则本身进行修改？非约束性的讨论对我们来说没有兴趣。

5.) 如果您想见我，在我看来最合适的是您来我的办公室，而不是反过来。

6.) 您其中一封信的语气让人怀疑您对此事进行实质性讨论的意愿不高。

ARTICLE 8. Prior to filing respectively the petition and the answer to same, as per Art. (7) hereof, both parties shall make sure of the consent of their respective nominees to act as their arbitrators and, having obtained such consent in written form, shall attach such document to the application and/or answer respectively filed by them.

ARTICLE 9. The Arbitrators so elected by the parties shall jointly elect an Umpire who will conduct the hearings and will have a decisive vote for the decision to be passed in the event of the Arbitrators' failure to agree.

Should the Arbitrators, for three (3) days as from date of nomination of the second Arbitrator, fail to come to an understanding as to the person of the Umpire to be jointly elected by them, such Umpire shall be appointed by the Chairman of the COMMITTEE.

ARTICLE 10. After the Defendants' answer has reached the Chairman's office and the Umpire has been duly elected or appointed as per Art. (9) hereof, the said Umpire shall set a date for the first hearing which shall take place within the next eight (8) clear days as from date of election or appointment of such Umpire.

The said Umpire shall then summon the parties to appear on the date so fixed, together with their respective witnesses taking care that all the evidence available be produced at the hearing. The Umpire shall also see to it that both parties sign a Submission, in a form accepted as valid by Chinese Law, accepting in advance as final and binding whatever decision may be rendered by the Arbitration Court herein.

ARTICLE 11. In certain instances where the nature of the case indicates such measure, the Umpire may direct the parties to deposit with the Arbitration Court the object of the dispute. In such cases, the Submission to be signed as per Art. (10) hereof shall contain an explicit provision to the effect that, in execution of the award rendered, the Court may immediately deliver the said object to the winning party.

In all other cases it shall be the care of the winning party to see to it that the award is duly executed.

ARTICLE 12. The COMMITTEE shall draw up and publish two (2) lists containing the names of potential arbitrators and umpires respectively; parties applying for or submitting to arbitration as well as arbitrators electing their umpire may elect respectively their arbitrators and umpire ONLY from among persons figuring on the said lists, to the total exclusion of all outsiders.

The totality of the persons enumerated in the said lists will form the ARBITRATION COMMITTEE, to whose Chairman, nominated by the Chairman of the COMMITTEE, the latter will delegate powers to act on his behalf.

ARTICLE 13. Once elected, arbitrators and umpires must attend the case from beginning to conclusion. If, for reasons of health or on other weighty grounds, an arbitrator and/or umpire is compelled to suspend his activity in a given case and is replaced by a substitute, the entire procedure, if already begun, shall be resumed and recapitulated.

Arbitrators and Umpires shall be deemed to be barred from acting in such capacity by the same reasons, mutatis mutandis, as, according to the Chinese Code of Civil Procedure, entitle parties to demand the withdrawal of a judge.

ARTICLE 14. The Chairman of the COMMITTEE shall, at his discretion, determine the auxiliary organs of the Arbitration Court herein (e. g. official scribe etc.), shall nominate the persons to function in such respective capacities, and determine the extent of their respective remuneration, if any.

The said Chairman will also see to it that printed forms for the Submission as per Art. (10) hereof and for the declaration of consent of nominees to act as arbitrators be placed at the disposal of parties intending to file applications for arbitration or complying with notice to elect an arbitrator.

The Chairman of the COMMITTEE will furthermore be in charge of elaborating detailed rules for the enactment of the present Regulations and will make it his care to have them put into operation.

ARTICLE 15. The present Regulations shall be valid unless and until amended and/or wholly or partly superseded by order of the COMMITTEE.

第八条. 在分别提交请愿书及对此的答辩状之前，按照本规章第七条之规定，双方应确保其各自提名的仲裁员同意担任此职，并在获得书面同意后，将该文件附于各自提交的申请和/或答辩状中。

第九条. 由双方选出的仲裁员应共同推选一名公断人，由其主持听证会，并在仲裁员无法达成一致意见时，对所作决定拥有决定性的一票。

若自第二名仲裁员提名之日起三（3）天内，仲裁员未能就共同推选的公断人人选达成共识，则该公断人应由委员会主席任命。

第十条. 在被告的答辩状送达主席办公室，且公断人已按照本规章第九条之规定正式选出或任命后，该公断人应确定首次听证的日期，该日期应在公断人选出或任命之日起接下来的八（8）个整天内进行。

随后，该公断人应传唤双方于上述确定的日期出庭，并携各自证人出席，以确保所有可用证据均在听证会上出示。公断人还应确保双方签署一份符合中国法律认可格式的提交书，预先接受本仲裁庭可能作出的任何决定为最终且具有约束力的裁决。

第十一条. 在某些案件性质表明有必要采取此类措施的情况下，公断人可指令双方将争议标的物存放于仲裁庭。在此类情况下，按照本规章第十条规定签署的提交书应包含明确条款，规定在执行裁决时，法庭可立即将该标的物交付给胜诉方。

在所有其他情况下，胜诉方应负责确保裁决得到适当执行。

第十二条. 委员会应编制并公布两（2）份名单，分别载有潜在仲裁员和公断人的姓名；申请或提交仲裁的当事人以及选举公断人的仲裁员，只能从上述名单所列人员中分别选举其仲裁员和公断人，完全排除名单以外的人员。

上述名单所列全部人员将组成仲裁委员会，委员会主席将向其提名的主席授予代表其行事的权力。

第十三条. 仲裁员和公断人一经选出，必须从头至尾参与案件处理。如果因健康原因或其他重大理由，仲裁员和/或公断人被迫中止其在特定案件中的工作并由替补人员接替，则若程序已经开始，应重新开始并复述整个程序。

仲裁员和公断人不得担任此职务的理由，比照《中国民事诉讼法》中允许当事人要求法官回避的理由，作相应变更适用。

第十四条. 委员会主席可自行决定本仲裁庭的辅助机构（例如官方书记员等），提名担任这些相应职务的人员，并确定其各自的报酬数额（如有）。

该主席还将确保向打算提交仲裁申请或遵照通知选举仲裁员的当事人提供按照本规章第十条规定的提交书印刷格式，以及被提名人同意担任仲裁员的声明书印刷格式。

此外，委员会主席将负责制定实施本规章的详细规则，并负责使其投入运作。

第十五条. 本规章有效，除非且直到被委员会命令修改和/或全部或部分取代。

RULES REGULATING ARBITRATION
in
DISPUTES OF JEWISH EMIGRANTS

ARTICLE 1. The "Committee' for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai'
(hereinafter to be designated as the "COMMITTEE") expects all emigrants to submit their
legal disputes, insofar as same cannot be amicably settled, to the arbitration of the Court as
organized under the present Rules.

Non-observance of the above will entail the forfeiture by the responsible party of
all the privileges, facilities, support etc., extended to such party by the COMMITTEE, besides
other and further sanctions which the said COMMITTEE may see fit to apply.

ARTICLE 2. The Arbitration Court organized under the present Rules is created for the purpose
of deciding all disputes in the nature of CIVIL cases, existing and arising between or among
emigrants, but may also take decisions where only one of the parties is an emigrant, provided
the other party, not an emigrant, give his/her consents in a legally valid form for the matter
to be submitted to the said Arbitration Court.

The latter shall handle and take decisions in all and any cases where the value of the
litigation is not below CNC $ 50.00

ARTICLE 3. As a rule, proceedings before the Arbitration Court herein entail no costs for the
parties, except in cases where the nature of the dispute or the value involved would afford
the Court sufficient reason to charge costs; the latter would be accounted for in accordance
with local custom.

The question of costs shall be decided at the initial hearing prior to the commence-
ment of the proceedings proper and, should the tribunal take a decision to the effect that
costs are to be charged, a Ruling shall be rendered, fixing the approximate amount of such
costs, to be deposited with the said Court in advance. The said Ruling is to determine whe-
ther both or one and if so, which of the parties shall deposit the amount representing costs,
if any.

The final award to be given by the tribunal shall determine the extent and proportion
of the parties' liability for costs, if any.

ARTICLE 4. Proceedings before the Arbitration Court herein shall, as a rule, be verbal and
contradictory. Should the nature of the case, however, so require, the Court may decide
that the parties should prepare briefs in writing in order to explain their case in full to the
Court.

Accurate Minutes shall be kept of all proceedings. Original Exhibits, if any, shall
be handed back to the parties upon termination of the proceedings, unless the nature of the
case indicates otherwise.

The Final Award of the Arbitration Court shall always be made in writing, exposing
the reasons for the decisions taken. The Chairman of the Arbitration Committee (as per
Art. 12 here inbelow) shall, if he deems it necessary, be at liberty to publish the said Award, in
part or in extenso, in a form at his discretion.

ARTICLE 5. The parties appearing before the Arbitration Court shall handle their case person-
ally, without the assistance of lawyeres, unless the value of the litigation is over CNC $ 500.00

Whenever the value involved exceeds the above figure and the parties are, conse-
quently, allowed to be represented by lawyers, it will be at the discretion of the Court to
consider attorneys' fees as part of the costs and decide as to which of the parties shall bear
such costs as per Art.(3) hereof.

ARTICLE 6. In rendering the decision, the Arbitration Court shall apply such law as it may be
presumed to have been the intention of the parties to apply at the time the act-in-the-law or
transaction, out of which the dispute arises, was respectively done or concluded. Should it
prove impossible to ascertain such law or should same be inapplicable in Shanghai, then and
in such cases the dispute is to be settled in accordance with Chinese Law and/or prevailing
local custom.

ARTICLE 7. A party desirous of referring a case to arbitration in the spirit of the present Rules
shall address a Petition in duplicate to such effect to the Chairman of the COMMITTEE,
briefly explaining his/her case and at the same time nominating his/her arbitrator. One copy
of such Petition is to be served on the adverse party within three(3) days from date of receipt
thereof by the Chairman's office. The Defendant is to give a written answer to such Petition,
within eight (8) clear days from date of service of same on him; in such answer, the Defend-
ant shall also name his arbitrator.

犹太移民纠纷仲裁规则

第一条. “上海欧洲犹太难民援助委员会”（以下简称“委员会”）期望所有移民将其法律纠纷，在无法友好解决的情况下，提交给根据本规则组织的法庭进行仲裁。

不遵守上述规定将导致责任方丧失委员会向其提供的所有特权、便利、支持等，此外还可能面临委员会认为适宜施加的其他进一步制裁。

第二条. 根据本规则组织的仲裁法庭旨在裁决移民之间或之中存在及产生的所有民事性质的纠纷，但如果只有一方是移民，只要另一方（非移民）以法律有效的形式同意将事项提交给该仲裁法庭，法庭也可作出决定。

后者应处理并裁决诉讼标的额不低于法币50.00元的所有案件。

第三条. 原则上，在本仲裁庭进行的程序不向当事人收取费用，除非纠纷的性质或涉及金额使法庭有充分理由收取费用；后者将按照当地习惯进行核算。

费用问题应在正式程序开始前的初次听证会上决定，如果法庭决定收取费用，应发布一项裁定，确定大致费用金额，需预先存入该法庭。该裁定应确定是由双方还是由一方（如果是后者，则指明哪一方）存入代表费用的金额（如有）。

法庭作出的最终裁决应确定当事人对费用（如有）承担责任的范围和比例。

第四条. 在本仲裁庭进行的程序原则上应为口头和对质式的。然而，如果案件性质有此要求，法庭可决定当事人应准备书面简报，以便向法庭充分解释其案情。

所有程序均应保留准确的笔录。原始证物（如有）应在程序结束时退还给当事人，除非案件性质另有指示。

仲裁庭的最终裁决始终应以书面形式作出，并阐述作出决定的理由。仲裁委员会主席（如下文第十二条所述）如果认为必要，有权以其自行决定的形式部分或全文公布该裁决。

第五条. 出庭仲裁庭的当事人应亲自处理其案件，不得由律师协助，除非诉讼标的额超过法币500.00元。

每当涉及金额超过上述数字，因此允许当事人由律师代理时，法庭有权酌情将律师费视为费用的一部分，并根据本规章第三条决定由哪一方承担此类费用。

第六条. 在作出决定时，仲裁庭应适用在引起纠纷的法律行为或交易分别完成或缔结时，可推定为当事人意图适用的法律。如果证明无法查明该法律，或者该法律在上海不适用，则在此类情况下，纠纷应按照中国法律和/或 prevailing local custom（现行当地习俗）解决。

Establishment of "Court of Arbitration"

established an "Arbitration Court" at 66 Alcock Road.
The Chairman thereof is Dr. A. Grossman, 20 Canton Road,
and the Secretary Dr. Hans Norbert Freundlich, 66 Alcock

cases.

prospective claimants together with the rules governing

and Umpires are entirely voluntary and the list of such
is made up of any Shanghai foreign resident (Jewish or
otherwise) who is prepared to act as such. I am informed
by Dr. Freundlich that the list of Arbitrators at present
contains 30 names.

RULES REGULATING ARBITRATION
in
DISPUTES OF JEWISH EMIGRANTS

ARTICLE 1. The "Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai' (hereinafter to be designated as the "COMMITTEE") expects all emigrants to submit their legal disputes, insofar as same cannot be amicably settled, to the arbitration of the Court as organized under the present Rules.

Non-observance of the above will entail the forfeiture by the responsible party of all the privileges, facilities, support etc., extended to such party by the COMMITTEE, besides other and further sanctions which the said COMMITTEE may see fit to apply.

ARTICLE 2. The Arbitration Court organized under the present Rules is created for the purpose of deciding all disputes in the nature of CIVIL cases, existing and arising between or among emigrants, but may also take decisions where only one of the parties is an emigrant, provided the other party, not an emigrant, give his/her consents in a legally valid form for the matter to be submitted to the said Arbitration Court.

The latter shall handle and take decisions in all and any cases where the value of the litigation is not below CNC $ 50.00

ARTICLE 3. As a rule, proceedings before the Arbitration Court herein entail no costs for the parties, except in cases where the nature of the dispute or the value involved would afford the Court sufficient reason to charge costs; the latter would be accounted for in accordance with local custom.

The question of costs shall be decided at the initial hearing prior to the commencement of the proceedings proper and, should the tribunal take a decision to the effect that costs are to be charged, a Ruling shall be rendered, fixing the approximate amount of such costs, to be deposited with the said Court in advance. The said Ruling is to determine whether both or one and if so, which of the parties shall deposit the amount representing costs, if any.

The final award to be given by the tribu**〔此处转录不清〕**shall determine the extent and proportion of the parties' liability for costs, if any.

ARTICLE 4. Proceedings before the Arbitration **〔此处转录不清〕**urt herein shall, as a rule, be verbal and contradictory. Should the nature of the case, however, so require, the Court may decide that the parties should prepare briefs in writing in order to explain their case in full to the Court.

Accurate Minutes shall be kept of all proceedings. Original Exhibits, if any, shall be handed back to the parties upon termination of the proceedings, unless the nature of the case indicates otherwise.

The Final Award of the Arbitration Court shall always be made in writing, exposing the reasons for the decisions taken. The Chairman of the Arbitration Committee (as per Art. 12 hereinbelow) shall, if he deems it necessary, be at liberty to publish the said Award, in part or in extenso, in a form at his discretion.

ARTICLE 5. The parties appearing before the Arbitration Court shall handle their case personally, without the assistance of lawyers, unless the value of the litigation is over CNC $ 500.00

Whenever the value involved exceeds the above figure and the parties are, consequently, allowed to be represented by lawyers, it will be at the discretion of the Court to consider attorneys' fees as part of the costs and decide as to which of the parties shall bear such costs as per Art.(3) hereof.

ARTICLE 6. In rendering the decision, the Arbitration Court shall apply such law as it may be presumed to have been the intention of the parties to apply at the time the act-in-the-law or transaction, out of which the dispute arises, was respectively done or concluded. Should it prove impossible to ascertain such law or should same be inapplicable in Shanghai, then and in such cases the dispute is to be settled in accordance with Chinese Law and/or prevailing local custom.

ARTICLE 7. A party desirous of referring a case to arbitration in the spirit of the present Rules shall address a Petition in duplicate to such effect to the Chairman of the COMMITTEE, briefly explaining his/her case and at the same time nominating his/her arbitrator. One copy of such Petition is to be served on the adverse party within three (3) days from date of receipt thereof by the Chairman's office. The Defendant is to give a written answer to such Petition, within eight (8) clear days from date of service of same on him; in such answer, the Defendant shall also name his arbitrator.

犹太移民纠纷仲裁规则

第一条 “上海欧洲犹太难民援助委员会”（以下简称“委员会”）期望所有移民将其法律纠纷，在无法友好解决的情况下，提交给根据本规则组织的法庭进行仲裁。

不遵守上述规定者，责任方将被剥夺委员会向其提供的所有特权、便利、支持等，此外还可能面临该委员会认为适宜施加的其他进一步制裁。

第二条 根据本规则组织的仲裁法庭，旨在裁决移民之间或其中存在的及产生的所有具有民事案件性质的纠纷；但如果仅有一方为移民，而另一方非移民以法律上有效的形式同意将事项提交该仲裁法庭，则该法庭亦可作出裁决。

凡诉讼标的价值不低于法币50.00元的所有案件，均由该法庭处理并作出裁决。

第三条 原则上，在本仲裁法庭进行的程序不向当事人收取费用，除非纠纷的性质或涉及的价值使法庭有充分理由收取费用；后者将依照当地惯例计算。

费用问题应在正式程序开始前的初次听证会上决定，如果法庭决定收取费用，应发布一项裁定，确定该费用的大致金额，并需预先存入该法庭。该裁定应确定是由双方还是由一方（如果是后者，则指明哪一方）存入代表费用的金额（如有）。

由法庭作出的最终裁决〔此处转录不清〕应确定当事人对费用（如有）承担责任的范围和比例。

第四条 在本仲裁法庭〔此处转录不清〕进行的程序，原则上应为口头辩论式。然而，如果案件性质有此要求，法庭可决定当事人应准备书面诉状，以便向法庭充分解释其案情。

所有程序均应保存准确的笔录。原始证据（如有）应在程序终止时退还给当事人，除非案件性质表明另有必要。

仲裁法庭的最终裁决始终应以书面形式作出，并阐明所作决定的理由。仲裁委员会主席（如下文第12条所述）如认为必要，有权自行决定以部分或全文形式公布该裁决。

第五条 出庭于仲裁法庭的当事人应亲自处理其案件，不得由律师协助，除非诉讼标的价值超过法币500.00元。

每当涉及金额超过上述数额，因而允许当事人由律师代理时，法庭有权酌情将律师费视为费用的一部分，并根据本文第(3)条决定由哪一方承担此类费用。

第六条 仲裁法庭在作出裁决时，应适用在引起纠纷的法律行为或交易分别实施或达成时，可推定为当事人意图适用的法律。如果证明无法查明该法律，或者该法律在上海不适用，则在此类情况下，纠纷应依据中国法律和/或 prevailing local custom（现行当地习俗）予以解决。

第七条 希望本着本规则的精神将案件提交仲裁的一方，应向委员会主席提交一式两份的请愿书，简要说明其案情，同时提名其仲裁员。该请愿书的一份副本应在主席办公室收到之日起三（3）天内送达对方当事人。被告应在向其送达该请愿书之日起八（8）个整日内给予书面答复；在该答复中，被告也应提名其仲裁员。

ARTICLE 8. Prior to filing respectively the petition and the answer to same, as per Art. (7) hereof, both parties shall make sure of the consent of their respective nominees to act as their arbitrators and, having obtained such consent in written form, shall attach such document to the application and/or answer respectively filed by them.

ARTICLE 9. The Arbitrators so elected by the parties shall jointly elect an Umpire who will conduct the hearings and will have a decisive vote for the decision to be passed in the event of the Arbitrators' failure to agree.

Should the Arbitrators, for three (3) days as from date of nomination of the second Arbitrator, fail to come to an understanding as to the person of the Umpire to be jointly elected by them, such Umpire shall be appointed by the Chairman of the COMMITTEE.

ARTICLE 10. After the Defendants' answer has reached the Chairman's office and the Umpire has been duly elected or appointed as per Art. (9) hereof, the said Umpire shall set a date for the first hearing which shall take place within the next eight (8) clear days as from date of election or appointment of such Umpire.

The said Umpire shall then summon the parties to appear on the date so fixed, together with their respective witnesses taking care that all the evidence available be produced at the hearing. The Umpire shall also see to it that both parties sign a Submission, in a form accepted as valid by Chinese Law, accepting in advance as final and binding whatever decision may be rendered by the Arbitration Court herein.

ARTICLE 11. In certain instances where the nature of the case indicates such measure, the Umpire may direct the parties to deposit with the Arbitration Court the object of the dispute. In such cases; the Submission to be signed as per Art. (10) hereof shall contain an explicit provision to the effect that, in execution of the award rendered, the Court may immediately deliver the said object to the winning party.

In all other cases it shall be the care of the winning party to see to it that the award is duly executed.

ARTICLE 12. The COMMITTEE shall draw up and publish two (2) lists containing the names of potential arbitrators and umpires respectively; parties applying for or submitting to arbitration as well as arbitrators electing their umpire may elect respectively their arbitrators and umpire ONLY from among persons figuring on the said lists, to the total exclusion of all outsiders.

The totality of the persons enumerated in the said lists will form the ARBITRATION COMMITTEE, to whose Chairman, nominated by the Chairman of the COMMITTEE, the latter will delegate powers to act on his behalf.

ARTICLE 13. Once elected, arbitrators and umpires must attend the case from beginning to conclusion. If, for reasons of health or on other weighty grounds, an arbitrator and/or umpire is compelled to suspend his activity in a given case and is replaced by a substitute, the entire procedure, if already begun, shall be resumed and recapitulated.

Arbitrators and Umpires shall be deemed to be barred from acting in such capacity by the same reasons, mutatis mutandis, as, according to the Chinese Code of Civil Procedure, entitle parties to demand the withdrawal of a judge.

ARTICLE 14. The Chairman of the COMMITTEE shall, at his discretion, determine the auxiliary organs of the Arbitration Court herein (e. g. official scribe etc.), shall nominate the persons to function in such respective capacities, and determine the extent of their respective remuneration, if any.

The said Chairman will also see to it that printed forms for the Submission as per Art. (10) hereof and for the declaration of consent of nominees to act as arbitrators be placed at the disposal of parties intending to file applications for arbitration or complying with notice to elect an arbitrator.

The Chairman of the COMMITTEE will furthermore be in charge of elaborating detailed rules for the enactment of the present Regulations and will make it his care to have them put into operation.

ARTICLE 15. The present Regulations shall be valid unless and until amended and/or wholly or partly superseded by order of the COMMITTEE.

第八条 在分别提交请愿书及对其的答复之前（依据本文第(7)条），双方应确保其各自提名人选同意担任其仲裁员，并在获得书面形式的同意后，将该文件附在其分别提交的申请和/或答复中。

第九条 由双方如此选出的仲裁员应共同选举一名公断人，由其主持听证会，并在仲裁员未能达成一致意见时，对所要通过的裁决拥有决定性的一票。

如果仲裁员在第二名仲裁员提名之日起三（3）天内，未能就共同选举的公断人人选达成共识，则该公断人应由委员会主席任命。

第十条 在被告的答复到达主席办公室，且公断人已根据本文第(9)条 duly elected or appointed（正式选举或任命）后，该公断人应确定第一次听证会的日期，该听证会应在该公断人选举或任命之日起接下来的八（8）个整日内举行。

随后，该公断人应传唤当事人在所定日期出庭，并携同其各自的证人，确保证据在听证会上全部出示。公断人还应确保双方签署一份符合中国法律认可的有效格式的提交书，预先接受本仲裁法庭可能作出的任何决定为最终且具有约束力。

第十一条 在某些案件性质表明需要采取此类措施的情况下，公断人可指令当事人将争议标的物存入仲裁法庭。在此类情况下，根据本文第(10)条签署的提交书应包含一项明确条款，规定在执行所作裁决时，法庭可立即将该标的物交付给胜诉方。

在所有其他情况下，应由胜诉方负责确保裁决得到 duly executed（妥善执行）。

第十二条 委员会应编制并公布两（2）份名单，分别载有潜在仲裁员和公断人的姓名；申请或提交仲裁的当事人以及选举公断人的仲裁员，只能从上述名单所列人员中分别选举其仲裁员和公断人，完全排除所有外部人员。

上述名单所列全部人员将组成仲裁委员会，委员会主席将把代表其行事的权力授予由委员会主席提名的仲裁委员会主席。

第十三条 仲裁员和公断人一经选出，必须从头到尾参与案件审理。如果因健康原因或其他重大理由，仲裁员和/或公断人被迫中止其在特定案件中的活动并由替补人员接替，则整个程序（如果已经开始）应重新开始并复述。

仲裁员和公断人被视为因相同理由（经必要修改）而被禁止以此身份行事，这些理由根据《中国民事诉讼法》赋予当事人要求法官回避的权利。

第十四条 委员会主席应自行决定本仲裁法庭的辅助机构（例如官方书记员等），提名担任相应职务的人员，并确定其各自的报酬（如有）额度。

该主席还应确保将用于本文第(10)条所述提交书的印刷表格，以及被提名人同意担任仲裁员的声明表格，提供给打算提交仲裁申请或响应选举仲裁员通知的当事人使用。

此外，委员会主席将负责制定实施本条例的详细规则，并负责使其投入运作。

第十五条 本条例有效，除非且直到被委员会命令修改和/或全部或部分取代。

German Jews Reported Setting
Up Own Courts On Alcock Rd.

Special Code “Promulgated” By “Judicial
Body” Declares Chinese Law Inapplicable;
Appoints Tribunal Officials

The alleged setting up of a judi-
cial court by German Jewish Re-
fugees here may be regarded as a
deliberate attempt to undermine
Chinese sovereign rights and if
proved true, will not be tolerated,
a high Chinese court official told
THE CHINA PRESS last night.

Pending a thorough investi-
gation of the situation, how-
ever, the official stated, Chin-
ese judicial authorities here will
take no steps against the
Jewish emigres. It was reveal-
ed that full reports were being
drafted for submission to the
national Government and to the
Shanghai Municipal Council.

The official pointed out that
the German Government hav-
ing already relinquished its ex-
tra-territorial rights in China,
were not entitled to rights simi-
lar to those of other nationals
here.

Reports that such a court had
been set up by the Jewish refugees
were first circulated in the Chin-
ese press on Saturday. The re-
ports indicated that the tribunal
was located at 66 Alcock Road in
the Eastern District.

Own Laws Alleged

According to the reports, the
court was first discovered by a
Chinese attorney at law, Mr. Tsai
Hiu-peh, who in a letter to the
Chinese Lawyer’s Association gave
details of the institution.

In his letter, Mr. Tsai stated
that besides identifying the court
with a large wooden sign hung over
the front entrance at the above-
mentioned address, the German
(Continued on Page 5, Col. 4.)

German Jews Said
Setting Up Own Courts
On Alcock Rd.

(Continued from Page 1, Col. 5.)

Jews had also drafted a code which
allegedly governs the operation of
the tribunal.

Among rules “promulgated” by
the court are the following:

1. That Jewish refugees here
are forbidden to take their cases
to Chinese courts here and those
who violate this rule will be given
due punishment;

2. That a special fee will be
levied against any Jewish refugee
who invokes the service of the
court;

3. That only lawyers registered
with the court are permitted to ap-
pear on behalf of clients;

4. That Chinese judicial codes
will be inapplicable in the court;

5. That judges and other officers
of the court are appointees of the
court and receive remunerations
from the court.

It was reported that the court at
present convenes only between the
hours of 10 and 12 a.m. on Tues-
days and Fridays and that more
than a dozen cases had already
been tried by the new institution.

Infringement Claimed

The German-Jewish establish-
ment, being located at areas within
the control of the International
Settlement, infringes directly on
the jurisdiction of the First Special
District Court which was set up
under an agreement between the
Consular Body here and the Chin-
ese Government nearly a decade
ago.

Repeated attempts have been
made by the Japanese-controlled
“Shanghai Special Municipality”
to take over the control of the
court but thus far the Consular
Body has yet refused to give its
consent. Rumors that force would
be used to gain such a control were
met by the stationing of British
troops in the Court compound on
North Chekiang Road.

“司法机构”“颁布”特别法典，宣称中国法律不适用；任命法庭官员

一位中国法院高级官员昨晚对《字林西报》（THE CHINA PRESS）表示，据称在沪的德籍犹太难民设立司法法庭之举，可被视为蓄意破坏中国主权的行为，若经查证属实，将不予容忍。

然而，该官员指出，在对局势进行彻底调查之前，在沪的中国司法机关不会对犹太流亡者采取任何行动。据悉，目前正起草完整报告，以便提交给国民政府和上海公共租界工部局。

该官员指出，鉴于德国政府已放弃其在华的治外法权，故无权享有与其他外籍人士在此地类似的權利。

关于犹太难民设立此类法庭的报道，首先于周六在中国报刊上流传。报道指出，该法庭位于东区阿尔科克路66号。

据称拥有自家法律

据报道，该法庭最初由一位中国执业律师蔡希伯（Tsai Hiou-peh，音译）先生发现，他在致上海律师公会的一封信中详细披露了该机构的情况。

蔡先生在信中指出，除了在上述地址的前门上方悬挂一块大型木制招牌以标识该法庭外，德籍
（续第5页，第4栏。）

据称德籍犹太人
在阿尔科克路设立自家法庭

（续自第1页，第5栏。）

犹太人还起草了一部据称管辖该法庭运作的法典。

据该法庭“颁布”的规则包括以下内容：

1. 禁止在沪的犹太难民将在沪案件诉诸中国法庭，违反此规则者将受到相应惩罚；

2. 向任何求助于该法庭服务的犹太难民征收特别费用；

3. 仅允许在该法庭注册的律师代表当事人出庭；

4. 中国司法法典在该法庭不适用；

5. 法官及其他法庭官员由法庭任命，并从法庭领取薪酬。

据报道，该法庭目前仅在每周二和周五上午10点至12点之间开庭，且该新机构已审理了十多起案件。

声称侵权

该德籍犹太人机构位于国际租界控制区域内，直接侵犯了第一特区地方法院的管辖权。该法院是近十年前由驻沪领事团与中国政府根据协议设立的。

受日本控制的“上海特别市政府”曾多次试图接管该法院的控制权，但迄今为止，领事团仍拒绝同意。针对有关将使用武力夺取控制权的谣言，英国军队被部署在北浙江路的法院大院内予以应对。

ARTICLE 8. Prior to filing respectively the petition and the answer to same, as per Art. (7) hereof, both parties shall make sure of the consent of their respective nominees to act as their arbitrators and, having obtained such consent in written form, shall attach such document to the application and/or answer respectively filed by them.

ARTICLE 9. The Arbitrators so elected by the parties shall jointly elect an Umpire who will conduct the hearings and will have a decisive vote for the decision to be passed in the event of the Arbitrators' failure to agree.

Should the Arbitrators, for three (3) days as from date of nomination of the second Arbitrator, fail to come to an understanding as to the person of the Umpire to be jointly elected by them, such Umpire shall be appointed by the Chairman of the COMMITTEE.

ARTICLE 10. After the Defendants' answer has reached the Chairman's office and the Umpire has been duly elected or appointed as per Art. (9) hereof, the said Umpire shall set a date for the first hearing which shall take place within the next eight (8) clear days as from date of election or appointment of such Umpire.

The said Umpire shall then summon the parties to appear on the date so fixed, together with their respective witnesses taking care that all the evidence available be produced at the hearing. The Umpire shall also see to it that both parties sign a Submission, in a form accepted as valid by Chinese Law, accepting in advance as final and binding whatever decision may be rendered by the Arbitration Court herein.

ARTICLE 11. In certain instances where the nature of the case indicates such measure, the Umpire may direct the parties to deposit with the Arbitration Court the object of the dispute. In such cases, the Submission to be signed as per Art. (10) hereof shall contain an explicit provision to the effect that, in execution of the award rendered, the Court may immediately deliver the said object to the winning party.

In all other cases it shall be the care of the winning party to see to it that the award is duly executed.

ARTICLE 12. The COMMITTEE shall draw up and publish two (2) lists containing the names of potential arbitrators and umpires respectively; parties applying for or submitting to arbitration as well as arbitrators electing their umpire may elect respectively their arbitrators and umpire ONLY from among persons figuring on the said lists, to the total exclusion of all outsiders.

The totality of the persons enumerated in the said lists will form the ARBITRATION COMMITTEE, to whose Chairman, nominated by the Chairman of the COMMITTEE, the latter will delegate powers to act on his behalf.

ARTICLE 13. Once elected, arbitrators and umpires must attend the case from beginning to conclusion. If, for reasons of health or on other weighty grounds, an arbitrator and/or umpire is compelled to suspend his activity in a given case and is replaced by a substitute, the entire procedure, if already begun, shall be resumed and recapitulated.

Arbitrators and Umpires shall be deemed to be barred from acting in such capacity by the same reasons, mutatis mutandis, as, according to the Chinese Code of Civil Procedure, entitle parties to demand the withdrawal of a judge.

ARTICLE 14. The Chairman of the COMMITTEE shall, at his discretion, determine the auxiliary organs of the Arbitration Court herein (e. g. official scribe etc.), shall nominate the persons to function in such respective capacities, and determine the extent of their respective remuneration, if any.

The said Chairman will also see to it that printed forms for the Submission as per Art. (10) hereof and for the declaration of consent of nominees to act as arbitrators be placed at the disposal of parties intending to file applications for arbitration or complying with notice to elect an arbitrator.

The Chairman of the COMMITTEE will furthermore be in charge of elaborating detailed rules for the enactment of the present Regulations and will make it his care to have them put into operation.

ARTICLE 15. The present Regulations shall be valid unless and until amended and/or wholly or partly superseded by order of the COMMITTEE.

第十一条. 在某些情况下，若案件性质表明有必要采取此类措施，公断人可指令双方将争议标的物存放于仲裁法庭。在此类情况下，依照本规章第十条规定签署的提交仲裁书应包含明确条款，规定在执行裁决时，法庭可立即将该标的物交付给胜诉方。

在所有其他情况下，胜诉方应负责确保裁决得到适当执行。

第十二条. 委员会应编制并公布两（2）份名单，分别载有潜在仲裁员和公断人的姓名；申请或提交仲裁的当事人以及选举公断人的仲裁员，只能从上述名单所列人员中分别选举其仲裁员和公断人，完全排除所有外部人员。

上述名单所列全部人员将组成仲裁委员会，委员会主席将向其提名的主席授予代表其行事的权力。

第十三条. 仲裁员和公断人一经选出，必须从头到尾参与案件处理。如果因健康原因或其他重大理由，仲裁员和/或公断人被迫中止在特定案件中的活动并由替补人员接替，则若程序已经开始，应重新开始并复述整个程序。

仲裁员和公断人不得以此身份行事的原因，比照《中国民事诉讼法》中允许当事人要求法官回避的理由，作相应变更适用。

第十四条. 委员会主席可自行决定本仲裁法庭的辅助机构（例如官方书记员等），提名担任这些相应职务的人员，并确定其各自的薪酬数额（如有）。

该主席还将确保将依照本规章第十条规定的提交仲裁书印刷表格，以及被提名人同意担任仲裁员的声明表格，提供给打算提交仲裁申请或遵从通知选举仲裁员的当事人使用。

此外，委员会主席将负责制定实施本规章的详细规则，并负责使其投入运作。

第十五条. 本规章有效，除非且直到经委员会命令修改和/或全部或部分取代。

RULES REGULATING ARBITRATION
in
DISPUTES OF JEWISH EMIGRANTS

ARTICLE 1. The "Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai'
(hereinafter to be designated as the "COMMITTEE") expects all emigrants to submit their
legal disputes, insofar as same cannot be amicably settled, to the arbitration of the Court as
organized under the present Rules.

Non-observance of the above will entail the forfeiture by the responsible party of
all the privileges, facilities, support etc., extended to such party by the COMMITTEE, besides
other and further sanctions which the said COMMITTEE may see fit to apply.

ARTICLE 2. The Arbitration Court organized under the present Rules is created for the purpose
of deciding all disputes in the nature of CIVIL cases, existing and arising between or among
emigrants, but may also take decisions where only one of the parties is an emigrant, provided
the other party, not an emigrant, give his/her consents in a legally valid form for the matter
to be submitted to the said Arbitration Court.

The latter shall handle and take decisions in all and any cases where the value of the
litigation is not below CNC $ 50.00

ARTICLE 3. As a rule, proceedings before the Arbitration Court herein entail no costs for the
parties, except in cases where the nature of the dispute or the value involved would afford
the Court sufficient reason to charge costs; the latter would be accounted for in accordance
with local custom.

The question of costs shall be decided at the initial hearing prior to the commence-
ment of the proceedings proper and, should the tribunal take a decision to the effect that
costs are to be charged, a Ruling shall be rendered, fixing the approximate amount of such
costs, to be deposited with the said Court in advance. The said Ruling is to determine whe-
ther both or one and if so, which of the parties shall deposit the amount representing costs,
if any.

The final award to be given by the tribunal shall determine the extent and proportion
of the parties' liability for costs, if any.

ARTICLE 4. Proceedings before the Arbitration Court herein shall, as a rule, be verbal and
contradictory. Should the nature of the case, however, so require, the Court may decide
that the parties should prepare briefs in writing in order to explain their case in full to the
Court.

Accurate Minutes shall be kept of all proceedings. Original Exhibits, if any, shall
be handed back to the parties upon termination of the proceedings, unless the nature of the
case indicates otherwise.

The Final Award of the Arbitration Court shall always be made in writing, exposing
the reasons for the decisions taken. The Chairman of the Arbitration Committee (as per
Art: 12 hereinbelow) shall, if he deems it necessary, be at liberty to publish the said Award, in
part or in extenso, in a form at his discretion.

ARTICLE 5. The parties appearing before the Arbitration Court shall handle their case person-
ally, without the assistance of lawyers, unless the value of the litigation is over CNC $ 500.00

Whenever the value involved exceeds the above figure and the parties are, conse-
quently, allowed to be represented by lawyers, it will be at the discretion of the Court to
consider attorneys' fees as part of the costs and decide as to which of the parties shall bear
such costs as per Art. (3) hereof.

ARTICLE 6. In rendering the decision, the Arbitration Court shall apply such law as it may be
presumed to have been the intention of the parties to apply at the time the act-in-the-law or
transaction, out of which the dispute arises, was respectively done or concluded. Should it
prove impossible to ascertain such law or should same be inapplicable in Shanghai, then and
in such cases the dispute is to be settled in accordance with Chinese Law and/or prevailing
local custom.

ARTICLE 7. A party desirous of referring a case to arbitration in the spirit of the present Rules'
shall address a Petition in duplicate to such effect to the Chairman of the COMMITTEE,
briefly explaining his/her case and at the same time nominating his/her arbitrator. One copy
of such Petition is to be served on the adverse party within three (3) days from date of receipt
thereof by the Chairman's office. The Defendant is to give a written answer to such Petition,
within eight (8) clear days from date of service of same on him; in such answer, the Defend-
ant shall also name his arbitrator.

关于犹太移民纠纷的仲裁规则

第一条 “上海欧洲犹太难民援助委员会”（以下简称“委员会”）期望所有移民在无法友好解决其法律纠纷时，将其提交给根据本规则组建的法庭进行仲裁。

不遵守上述规定将导致责任方丧失委员会向其提供的所有特权、便利、支持等，此外还可能面临该委员会认为适宜施加的其他进一步制裁。

第二条 根据本规则组建的仲裁法庭旨在裁决移民之间或其中存在的及产生的所有具有民事案件性质的纠纷，但如果仅有一方为移民，而另一方非移民以法律上有效的形式同意将事项提交所述仲裁法庭，则该法庭亦可作出裁决。

对于诉讼标的价值不低于法币50.00元的所有案件，后者应予处理并作出裁决。

第三条 原则上，在本仲裁法庭进行的程序不向当事人收取费用，除非争议的性质或涉及的金额使法庭有充分理由收取费用；后者将按照当地惯例计算。

费用问题应在正式程序开始前的初次听证会上决定，如果法庭决定收取费用，应发布一项裁定，确定该费用的大致金额，并需预先存入所述法庭。所述裁定应确定是由双方还是由一方（如果是后者，则指明哪一方）存入代表费用的金额（如有）。

法庭作出的最终裁决应确定当事人对费用（如有）承担责任的范围和比例。

第四条 原则上，在本仲裁法庭进行的程序应为口头且对抗式的。然而，如果案件性质有此要求，法庭可决定当事人应准备书面诉状，以便向法庭充分解释其案情。

所有程序均应保存准确的笔录。原始证据（如有）应在程序终止时退还给当事人，除非案件性质另有指示。

仲裁法庭的最终裁决始终应以书面形式作出，并阐明作出决定的理由。仲裁委员会主席（如下文第12条所述）如认为必要，有权自行决定以部分或全文形式公布该裁决。

第五条 出庭于仲裁法庭的当事人应亲自处理其案件，不得由律师协助，除非诉讼标的价值超过法币500.00元。

每当涉及金额超过上述数额，因而允许当事人由律师代理时，法庭有权酌情将律师费视为费用的一部分，并根据本文第(3)条决定由哪一方承担此类费用。

第六条 仲裁法庭在作出裁决时，应适用在引起纠纷的法律行为或交易分别实施或达成时，推定为当事人意图适用的法律。如果证明无法查明该法律，或者该法律在上海不适用，则在此类情况下，纠纷应依据中国法律和/或 prevailing local custom（现行当地习惯）予以解决。

第七条 希望本着本规则的精神将案件提交仲裁的一方，应向委员会主席提交一式两份的请愿书，简要说明其案情，并同时提名其仲裁员。此类请愿书的一份副本应在主席办公室收到之日起三（3）天内送达对方当事人。被告应在向其送达该请愿书之日起八（8）个整天内给予书面答复；在该答复中，被告还应提名其仲裁员。

18. FEBRUAR, 1940 SHANGHAI JEWISH CHRONICLE

Die neue Schiedsgerichts
Ordnung

FUER STREITIGKEITEN ZWISCHEN EMIGRANTEN

ARTIKEL 1. Das "Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai", im Folgenden kurz COMMITTEE genannt, gibt hiermit der Erwartung Ausdruck, dass alle Emigranten ihre Rechtsstreitigkeiten vor Anrufung der zuständigen Behörden einem schiedsgerichtlichen Verfahren unterziehen.
Zur Behandlung solcher Streitfälle hat das Committee das "Schiedsgericht für europäische Emigranten in Shanghai", im Folgenden kurz "Schiedsgericht" genannt, geschaffen.

ARTIKEL 2. Das nach den folgenden Grundsätzen eingerichtete Schiedsgericht dient dem Zweck, alle jene Streitigkeiten zu behandeln, die weder friedlich geregelt werden können noch nach zwingender hiesiger Gesetzesvorschrift ausschliesslich der Entscheidung durch die zuständigen Behörden unterliegen, wobei es nur angerufen werden kann, wenn beide Streitteile Emigranten sind.

ARTIKEL 3. Es steht dem Schiedsgericht frei, die Behandlung bestimmter Streitfälle abzulehnen, was einer Begründung den Parteien gegenüber nicht bedarf.

ARTIKEL 4. Das Schiedsgericht besteht aus dem Obmann, einer bestimmten Anzahl von Vorsitzenden und Schiedsrichtern und dem entsprechenden ständigen Personal fuer die laufenden Geschäfte.

ARTIKEL 5. Obmann des Schiedsgerichtes ist der Rechtsbeistand des Committees. Ihm obliegt die Ueberwachung der Einrichtung und Geschäftsführung des Schiedsgerichtes und besonders die Herausgabe und Abänderung der schiedsgerichtlichen Verfahrensbestimmungen sowie die damit zusammenhängenden Ausführungsnormen, weiters der Abschluss von Dienstverträgen mit den Hilfsorganen des Schiedsgerichtes und schliesslich die ordnungsgemässe Führung der Listen der Vorsitzenden und Schiedsrichter.

ARTIKEL 6. Die Vorsitzenden und Schiedsrichter wirken ehrenamtlich und ohne jegliche Entschädigung. Im einzelnen Falle treten je ein Vorsitzender und zwei Schiedsrichter zusammen, um den Streit im Sinne der Schiedsgerichtsordnung zu entscheiden. Die Vorsitzenden und Schiedsrichter werden in Listen zusammengefasst.
Parteien, die ein Schiedsgerichtsverfahren beantragen oder sich einem solchen unterwerfen, haben ebenso wie Schiedsrichter, die einen Vorsitzenden wählen, ihren Schiedsrichter bezw. Vorsitzenden unter Ausschluss aller anderen Personen nur den oberwähnten Listen zu entnehmen. Ueber die Qualifikation der in die Listen der Vorsitzenden und Schiedsrichter aufzunehmenden Personen entscheidet der Obmann.
Dem Obmann ist ebenso wie den Vorsitzenden und Schiedsrichtern jede Betätigung untersagt, die eine Beratung oder Vertretung von Emigranten im Zusammenhang mit Schiedsgerichtsfällen beinhaltet.

ARTIKEL 7. Als dauerndes Hilfsorgan des Schiedsgerichtes wirkt ein Sekretär der die laufenden Geschäfte zu führen, die Vergleichsverhandlungen mit den Parteien gemäss Art 9 abzuhalten und die Streitverhandlungen vorzubereiten hat, bei denen ihm die Protokollführung obliegt. Der Sekretär darf keinerlei juridische Privatpraxis ausüben.

ARTIKEL 8. Das Schiedsgericht hat unter Beobachtung der in Shanghai geltenden zwingenden Gesetzesvorschriften dasjenige Recht anzuwenden, das die Parteien bei dem Vorgang oder Rechtsgeschäft, aus dem der Streitfall entstanden ist, offenbar angewendet haben wollten. Ist die Feststellung dieses Rechtes oder seine Anwendbarkeit in Shanghai nicht möglich, so ist der Streitfall nach chinesischem Recht und herrschenden Ortsbräuchen zu entscheiden.

ARTIKEL 9. Wer ein Schiedsgerichtsverfahren einzuleiten beabsichtigt, hat vorerst seine und seines Gegners Ladung zum Schiedsgericht zwecks Abhaltung eines Vergleichstermines zu erwirken. Ist der Vergleichsversuch ergebnislos geblieben, so ist, falls es sich bei dem Streite um Geld oder Geldeswert handelt, nunmehr das ordentliche Verfahren im Sinne der Schiedsgerichtsordnung einzuleiten; in sonstigen Fällen jedoch ist es den Parteien überlassen, ob und wie sie ihre Ansprüche weiterverfolgen.

ARTIKEL 10. Der Kläger, der eine schiedsgerichtliche Entscheidung seines Falles wünscht, hat zu diesem Zweck an das Schiedsgericht einen schriftlichen Antrag (Klage) in doppelter Ausfertigung zu richten, worin er seinen Fall kurz und erschöpfend auseinandersetzt, seine Beweismittel anführt und ein bestimmtes Begehren stellt. Gleichzeitig hat er seinen Schiedsrichter namhaft zu machen und dessen schriftliches Einverständnis diesem der Klage beizuschliessen.

ARTIKEL 11. Ein Exemplar der Klage ist der Gegenpartei (dem Beklagten) binnen drei Tagen nach Eingang beim Schiedsgericht zuzustellen. Der Beklagte hat binnen acht Tagen von dieser Zustellung an eine schriftliche Gegenäusserung (Klagebeantwortung) einzureichen, hierin seine Lage und erschöpfend sachverhaltsmässig zu geben, seine Beweismittel anzuführen und seinen Schiedsrichter namhaft zu machen, dessen schriftliches Einverständnis hierin ebenfalls beizuschliessen ist.

ARTIKEL 12. Erforderlichenfalls kann das Schiedsgericht den Parteien auftragen, vor Anberaumung der Streitverhandlung noch weitere vorbereitende Schriftsätze zur Aufklärung des Falles einzubringen.

18. 二月，1940年 《上海犹太纪事报》

新的仲裁庭
章程

适用于难民之间的纠纷

第一条 “上海欧洲犹太难民援助委员会”（以下简称“委员会”）兹表示期望，所有难民在诉诸主管当局之前，应将其法律争议提交仲裁程序处理。
为处理此类争议案件，委员会设立了“上海欧洲难民仲裁庭”（以下简称“仲裁庭”）。

第二条 根据下列原则设立的仲裁庭，旨在处理那些既无法和平解决，又非依据本地强制性法律规定必须 exclusively 由主管当局裁决的所有争议，且仅在争议双方均为难民时方可向其提出请求。

第三条 仲裁庭有权拒绝处理特定的争议案件，且无需向各方当事人说明理由。

第四条 仲裁庭由首席委员、一定数量的主席和仲裁员，以及负责日常事务的相应常设工作人员组成。

第五条 仲裁庭的首席委员由委员会的法律顾问担任。其职责包括监督仲裁庭的设立及业务管理，特别是发布和修改仲裁程序规定及相关的执行规范，与仲裁庭的辅助机构签订服务合同，以及妥善维护主席和仲裁员名册。

第六条 主席和仲裁员均为荣誉职务，不领取任何报酬。在具体案件中，由一名主席和两名仲裁员共同组成合议庭，按照仲裁庭章程对争议作出裁决。主席和仲裁员均列入名册。
申请或同意接受仲裁程序的当事人，以及选择主席的仲裁员，只能从上述名册中选定其仲裁员或主席，不得选择名册以外的其他人。首席委员决定列入主席和仲裁员名册的人员资格。
首席委员、主席及仲裁员均被禁止从事任何涉及就仲裁庭案件为难民提供咨询或代理的活动。

第七条 秘书作为仲裁庭的常设辅助机构，负责处理日常事务，按照第九条规定与当事人进行和解谈判，并准备争议审理工作，同时负责记录庭审笔录。秘书不得从事任何私人法律执业活动。

第八条 仲裁庭在遵守上海适用的强制性法律规定的情况下，应适用当事人在产生争议的诉讼或法律行为中显然意图适用的法律。如果无法确定该法律或其在上海无法适用，则应依据中国法律和当地 prevailing 习俗对争议案件作出裁决。

第九条 拟启动仲裁程序者，首先须取得传唤其本人及对方当事人前往仲裁庭举行和解会议的传票。如果和解尝试未果，且争议涉及金钱或金钱价值，则应按照仲裁庭章程启动正式程序；在其他情况下，是否以及如何继续追索其权利要求，由当事人自行决定。

第十条 希望就其案件获得仲裁裁决的申请人，须为此向仲裁庭提交书面申请（起诉书）一式两份，在其中简要而详尽地陈述其案情，列举证据，并提出具体的请求。同时，他须指明其选定的仲裁员，并将该仲裁员的书面同意书附于起诉书后。

第十一条 起诉书副本须在仲裁庭收到后的三天内送达对方当事人（被告）。被告须在送达之日起八天内提交书面答辩状，在其中详尽陈述其立场和事实情况，列举证据，并指明其选定的仲裁员，同样须附上该仲裁员的书面同意书。

第十二条 如有必要，仲裁庭可命令当事人在安排争议审理之前，提交进一步的预备性书面陈述，以澄清案情。

ARTIKEL 13. Nach Eingang der Klage und Klagebeantwortung haben die Schiedsrichter gemeinsam einen Vorsitzenden zu wählen. Diesem obliegt die Verhandlungsleitung und seine Stimme gibt den Ausschlag, wenn sich die Schiedsrichter über die Entscheidung nicht einigen können.
Sollten sich die Schiedsrichter nicht binnen drei Tagen nach Eingang der letzten Parteieneingabe: ueber die Person des Vorsitzenden verständigen, so ist ein solcher vom Obmann des Schiedsgerichtes zu ernennen.
ARTIKEL 14. Der Vorsitzende hat nach seiner ordnungsgemässen Wahl bzw. Ernennung die mündliche Streitverhandlung anzuberaumen, und zwar nach Möglichkeit für einen Termin innerhalb der nächsten acht Tage nach seiner Bestellung. Zu dieser Verhandlung sind die Parteien schriftlich zum persönlichen Erscheinen zu laden, und haben sämtliche ihnen erreichbaren Beweismittel, derer sie sich bedienen wollen, gleich mitzubringen.
ARTIKEL 15. Die einmal bestellten Schiedsrichter und Vorsitzenden sind verpflichtet, den betreffenden Fall vom Anfang bis zum Ende durchzuführen. Wenn ein Schiedsrichter oder Vorsitzender aus entsprechenden Gründen gezwungen ist, seine Mitwirkung in einem anhängigen Verfahren aufzugeben, so wird ein Ersatzmann für ihn bestellt und das gesamte bereits begonnene Verfahren neu eröffnet und wiederholt.
ARTIKEL 16. Schiedsrichter und Vorsitzende sind von der Ausübung dieses Amtes ausgeschlossen, wenn sinngemäss dieselben Umstände vorliegen, die die Partei nach chinesischem Recht zur Ablehnung eines Richters berechtigen würden.
ARTIKEL 17. Für das Verfahren vor dem Schiedsgericht gelten die Grundsätze der Mündlichkeit und des beiderseitigen Parteiengehörs.
ARTIKEL 18. Vor Eröffnung der Verhandlung hat der Vorsitzende die Parteien eine nach chinesischem Gesetz rechtswirksame Unterwerfungserklärung unterschreiben zu lassen, worin sie die Entscheidung des Schiedsgerichtes, wie immer diese ausfallen mag, im Voraus als endgültig und verbindlich anerkennen.
ARTIKEL 19. Die Parteien sollen grundsätzlich ihre Sache vor dem Schiedsgericht persönlich führen. Es kann ihnen jedoch nach dem Ermessen des Schiedsgerichtes gestattet werden, sich durch voll qualifizierte Rechtsanwälte vertreten zu lassen.
ARTIKEL 20. Das Schiedsgerichtsverfahren ist für die Parteien grundsätzlich kostenlos. Wenn es jedoch die besondere Art des Falles oder die Höhe des Streitwertes rechtfertigt, kann das Schiedsgericht Kosten in ortsüblichem Ausmass zur Vorschreibung bringen. Dieselben Grundsätze gelten für die Vergleichsverhandlung gemäss Art. 9.
ARTIKEL 21. Ueber das gesamte Verfahren ist genau Protokoll zu führen. Etwa von den Parteien beigebrachte Originalbelege sind ihnen nach Schluss des Verfahrens zurückzustellen. Die endgültige Entscheidung des Schiedsgerichtes (Schiedsspruch) ist stets schriftlich und unter Angabe der Entscheidungsgründe auszufertigen.
ARTIKEL 22. Für die ordentliche Vollstreckung des Schiedsspruchs hat die obsiegende Partei selbst zu sorgen.
ARTIKEL 23. Die vorliegende Schiedsgerichtsordnung ist in englischer und deutscher Sprache zu veröffentlichen. In Zweifelsfällen, die auf Textverschiedenheit beruhen, ist der englische Wortlaut als authentisch zu betrachten.
Die beiden Texte der Schiedsgerichtsordnung sowie die Listen der Vorsitzenden und Schiedsrichter haben stets zur Einsicht der Parteien und anderer Interessenten in der Geschäftsstelle des Schiedsgerichtes aufzuliegen. Dortselbst sind auch alle sonstigen Verlautbarungen des Schiedsgerichtes einzusehen.
ARTIKEL 24. Die vorliegende Schiedsgerichtsordnung tritt am 10. März 1940 in Wirksamkeit, zu welchem Zeitpunkt alle bisherigen Bestimmungen ausser Kraft treten. Sie gilt auch für die vor dem 10. März 1940 anhängig gemachten Streitfälle, soweit sie an diesem Tage nicht schon durch Schiedsspruch erledigt sind.

第十三条 在收到起诉书和答辩状后，仲裁员应共同选举一名主席。主席负责主持审理，并在仲裁员无法就裁决达成一致时，以其投票作为决定性一票。
如果仲裁员在收到最后一份当事人提交的文件后三天内未能就主席人选达成一致，则由仲裁庭首席委员任命一名主席。

第十四条 主席在正式当选或获任后，应安排口头争议审理，并尽可能在其受命后的八天内确定审理日期。应书面传唤当事人亲自出庭，并要求他们携带所有其希望使用的、能够获取的证据材料。

第十五条 一旦指定的仲裁员和主席有义务从头到尾处理相关案件。如果某位仲裁员或主席因正当理由被迫退出未决程序，将为其指定一名替补人员，并且整个已开始的程序将重新开启并重复进行。

第十六条 如果存在依照中国法律足以使当事人有权申请法官回避的情形，则相应的仲裁员和主席不得行使此职权。

第十七条 仲裁庭的程序适用口头原则和双方听审原则。

第十八条 在开庭审理前，主席应要求当事人签署一份根据中国法律具有法律效力的服从声明，在其中他们预先承认仲裁庭的裁决，无论结果如何，均为终局且具有约束力。

第十九条 当事人原则上应在仲裁庭亲自处理其案件。但经仲裁庭酌情决定，可允许其由具备完全资格的职业律师代理。

第二十条 仲裁程序对当事人原则上免费。但如果案件的特殊性质或争议金额的大小证明有此必要，仲裁庭可按当地惯例核定费用。同样的原则适用于根据第九条进行的和解谈判。

第二十一条 应对整个程序制作精确的笔录。当事人提交的任何原始凭证应在程序结束后退还给他们。仲裁庭的最终裁决（仲裁裁决书）必须采用书面形式，并阐明裁决理由。

第二十二条 胜诉方须自行负责仲裁裁决书的正常执行。

第二十三条 本仲裁庭章程应以英文和德文公布。在因文本差异而产生疑义的情况下，应以英文文本为准。
仲裁庭章程的两种文本以及主席和仲裁员名册，应始终置于仲裁庭办事处，供当事人及其他利害关系人查阅。仲裁庭的所有其他公告也可在该处查阅。

第二十四条 本仲裁庭章程于1940年3月10日生效，届时所有先前规定均告废止。本章程也适用于1940年3月10日之前已受理的争议案件，只要这些案件在该日尚未通过仲裁裁决结案。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS,

DEC 9 1938

New Refugee Court
Investigated

Chinese Bar Association
Studies Question of its
Legality

It was learned yesterday that the special committee of five well-known Chinese lawyers, formed by the Shanghai Bar Association to study the question whether or not it is right for German Jewish refugees in Shanghai to have a court of arbitration of their own, has held a meeting at which foreign legal experts interested in the question were also present. The report published by the Chinese press yesterday stating that the committee did not favour such a move and had already reported to the association so that the authorities might be petitioned for suppressive action was denied by a reliable foreign source.

The meeting was held on Saturday last under the chairmanship of Mr. Liu Shih-fang, one of the five lawyers on the committee. After listening to the arguments presented by two foreign legal experts in favour of the new court, the committeemen held discussions taking all arguments presented by both sides to the dispute into serious consideration. Some letters addressed to the committee by Chinese lawyers were also studied.

While it was reported that the committee did not favour the move on the ground that the new court does infringe upon the judicial system in this country, a foreign authority on the question stated yesterday that at the meeting he did not hear of unfavourable comments made. He thought that such meetings might be held again to discuss the matter but at present he hesitated to make a forecast on the final decision as Mr. Liu, the chairman, was in Hongkong.

The question interests not only legal practitioners but also judicial authorities for the new arbitration court has already begun functioning in Alcock Road. It was first discovered by a Chinese lawyer who opposed it. This lawyer wrote to the Shanghai Bar Association urging that the matter be investigated.

《字林西报》，

1938年12月9日

调查新的
难民法庭

律师公会
研究其
合法性问题

据悉，上海律师公会组建了一个由五位知名中国律师组成的特别委员会，以研究在上海的德国犹太难民拥有自己的仲裁法庭是否正确的问题，该委员会昨日举行了一次会议，关注此问题的外国法律专家也出席了会议。中文报纸昨日发布的报道声称，该委员会不赞成此举，并已向公会报告，以便请求当局采取压制行动，这一说法遭到了一位可靠的外国消息来源的否认。

会议于上周六举行，由委员会五位律师之一的刘世芳（音译）先生主持。在听取了两位支持新法庭的外国法律专家提出的论点后，委员会委员进行了讨论，认真考虑了争议双方提出的所有论点。会议还研究了由中国律师写给委员会的一些信件。

虽然有报道称，委员会以新法庭确实侵犯本国司法体系为由不赞成此举，但一位对此问题有权威的外国人士昨日表示，他在会议上并未听到反对意见。他认为可能会再次举行此类会议来讨论此事，但目前他犹豫是否对最终决定做出预测，因为主席刘先生正在香港。

这个问题不仅引起法律从业者的兴趣，也引起司法当局的关注，因为新的仲裁法庭已在阿尔科克路（Alcock Road）开始运作。最初是由一位反对该法庭的中国律师发现的。这位律师写信给上海律师公会，敦促对此事进行调查。

PRESS
FEB 2 2 1940

Emigre Court
Here Rapped
By Tribunal

Functions of the “Special Arbitration Court” instituted by German Jewish refugees were attacked in the First Special District Court yesterday morning in an action for damages caused by the loss of a coat filed by Mr. Henry C. Bacharach against Mr. Louis Eisenfelder, owner of the Cafe Louis, 1255 Bubbling Well Road.

The case was adjourned for judgment to Saturday.

On December 24, 1939, Mr. Henry C. Bacharach, German refugee, and his wife went to the Cafe Louis for lunch. A boy took Mrs. Bacharach’s coat, a black woollen coat with astrakhan trimmings, and hung it in the cloak room. Claiming the coat after lunch, Mrs. Bacharach was informed that it was missing.

Sues For Damages

Protracted discussions having proved futile, Mr. and Mrs. Bacharach placed the case in the hands of their attorney, Mr. Paul Premet, who filed a petition in the court claiming damages from Mr. Eisenfelder, also a German refugee, of $1,000 plus costs as compensation for the coat.

Mr. Premet pleaded that according to Article 607 of the Chinese Civil Code any cafe owner is responsible for coats and personal effects entrusted to him by his customers during their stay in the cafe.”

Appearing for Mr. Eisenfelder, Mr. Lou contended that the plaintiff must share this responsibility, as instead of entrusting the coat to the boy it would have been better to have placed it on a chair. To this Mr. Premet replied that the chairs in a cafe were not coat hangers, but were for the use of customers as seats.

“Arbitration Court” Hit

The question of the “Special Arbitration Court” arose when Mr. Premet produced two letters. One was addressed to him by Dr. Robert B. Michaelis, attorney, requesting Mr. Bacharach to withdraw his case before the Chinese court and to bring it before the “Special Arbitration Court.” The other summoned the plaintiff to drop the case and to agree to submit the dispute before the arbitration board or “further steps will be taken against him.”

In reading the above letters to the judge, Mr. Premet assumed that the magistrate would certainly not accept that a party threaten the other when the latter submits a litigation to a regular court instituted in China.

Upon the request of Mr. Premet, the judge asked the defendant if the letters in question were written according to his instructions and with his knowledge. Mr. Eisenfeld replied in the affirmative.

The judge severely reprimanded the defendant for instigating these threats because, the magistrate said, it is the right of anyone to come to the Court.

新闻报
1940年2月22日

流亡者法庭
在此遭法庭
斥责

昨日晨，在第一特区法院审理的一起索赔案中，德籍犹太难民设立的“特别仲裁法庭”之职能受到抨击。该案系亨利·C·巴拉赫（Henry C. Bacharach）先生起诉静安寺路1255号路易咖啡馆（Cafe Louis）业主路易斯·艾森费尔德（Louis Eisenfelder）先生，索赔因外套丢失造成的损失。

本案休庭，待周六宣判。

1939年12月24日，德籍难民亨利·C·巴拉赫先生及其夫人前往路易咖啡馆用午餐。一名男孩拿走了巴拉赫夫人的外套——一件饰有阿斯特拉罕羔皮边的黑色羊毛大衣，并将其挂在衣帽间。午餐后，巴拉赫夫人要求取回外套时，被告知外套已遗失。

起诉索赔

经长时间交涉无果，巴拉赫夫妇将此事委托给其代理律师保罗·普雷梅特（Paul Premet）先生处理。普雷梅特先生向法院提交诉状，向同为德籍难民的艾森费尔德先生索赔1,000美元及诉讼费用，作为外套损失的赔偿。

普雷梅特先生辩称，根据《中华民国民法典》第607条，任何咖啡馆业主均应对顾客在馆期间托付由其保管的外套及个人物品负责。

代表艾森费尔德先生出庭的卢（Lou）先生辩称，原告亦应分担此责任，因为与其将外套交给男孩，不如将其放在椅子上更为妥当。对此，普雷梅特先生反驳称，咖啡馆的椅子并非衣架，而是供顾客就座之用。

“仲裁法庭”受抨击

当普雷梅特先生出示两封信件时，“特别仲裁法庭”的问题随之浮现。其中一封由律师罗伯特·B·米夏埃利斯（Robert B. Michaelis）博士致函普雷梅特先生，要求巴拉赫先生撤回在中国法院的诉讼，并将案件提交至“特别仲裁法庭”。另一封信则传唤原告撤诉，并同意将争议提交仲裁委员会，否则将“对其采取进一步措施”。

普雷梅特先生向法官宣读上述信件时指出，想必法官绝不会认可一方在另一方将诉讼提交至中国设立的正规法院时对其进行威胁的做法。

应普雷梅特先生请求，法官询问被告，涉案信件是否按其指示并在其知情情况下撰写。艾森费尔德先生予以肯定答复。

法官严厉斥责被告煽动此类威胁行为，因为正如推事所言，任何人都有权诉诸法院。

CHINA PRESS.

DEC 10 1939

Probe Requested
Refugee Court
Inquiry Asked
By Legal Body

Recommendation that national judicial authorities be petitioned to restrict the operation of the so-called "Arbitration Court" of the Committee for the Assistance of European Refugees in Shanghai has been made by a special committee organized by the Shanghai Bar Association.

In its report published Friday, the special committee indicated that following an extensive study of the rules and regulations of the Jewish refugees' "court," it has come to the conclusion that the functions of the court constituted an attempt to infringe upon China's sovereignty over judicial matters.

In addition to naming its organization as a "court," the report further pointed out, officials of the "arbitration court" performed duties which were identical to those provided under the Chinese Laws for a legal tribunal. "This," it was added, "is an outright infringement of the nation's judicial power."

Grossmann Explains

Interviewed by a representative of THE CHINA PRESS, Dr. A. Grossmann, legal adviser to the refugee committee, indicated that he was not in a position to make a statement until he had seen the report. He said he doubted whether a report had been rendered by the Bar Association Committee in view of the fact that the Chairman of the Committee, Mr. Liu Shih-fong, was not in Shanghai.

In an earlier interview with THE CHINA PRESS, however, Dr. Grossmann pointed out that his organization had no intention of violating the Chinese law. He stated that the so-called "court" was merely an "arbitration committee" following a procedure even endorsed and recommended by Chinese law.

If authoritative Chinese quarters could show that the "court" violates Chinese law, he maintained he believed his organization would be fully prepared to make such changes as are required.

Meeting Held

While Chinese court officials had made no comment on the situation, quarters close to judicial circles indicated yesterday that the report of the Bar Association committee would be carefully scrutinized. It was believed likely that the national authorities in Chungking would be petitioned for instructions regarding the matter.

It was also learned yesterday that a meeting was called by the Special Committee last Saturday afternoon at which both Dr. Grossmann and a dissenting lawyer, Mr. A. Jovishoff, who opposes the "court" for not being in compliance with the Chinese law, were present.

At the meeting, it was reported, Dr. Grossmann and Mr. Jovishoff were called upon to explain their opinions. Communications to the Association from legal circles here were also studied and discussed before a draft of the report was proposed.

Discovered By Lawyer

The establishment of the "arbitration court" first became generally known in Shanghai last month when a Chinese lawyer, Mr. Philip Tsai, called the attention of the Chinese courts and the Bar Association to the set-up.

Acting upon Mr. Tsai's report, the Bar Association organized the committee of five members, who have been studying the situation for more than two weeks.

Besides the Bar Association, several Jewish refugee lawyers also expressed their opposition to the "court". They pointed out, among other things, that the refugee body had no right to use alleged coercive measures in compelling the refugees to submit to arbitration.

字林西报

1939年12月10日

要求调查
难民法庭
法律团体
请求查办

上海律师公会组织的一个特别委员会提出建议，恳请国家司法当局限制上海欧洲难民救济委员会所谓“仲裁法庭”的运作。

该特别委员会于周五发表的报告指出，在对犹太难民“法庭”的规章制度进行广泛研究后，得出结论认为，该法庭的职能构成了对中国司法主权的侵犯企图。

报告进一步指出，除了将其组织命名为“法庭”外，该“仲裁法庭”的官员所履行的职责与中国法律规定的法定审判机构之职责完全相同。报告补充称：“这是对国族司法权的公然侵犯。”

格罗斯曼解释

《字林西报》记者采访了难民委员会法律顾问A·格罗斯曼（A. Grossmann）博士，他表示在看到报告之前无法发表声明。他说，鉴于该委员会主席刘世芳（Liu Shih-fong，音译）先生不在上海，他怀疑律师公会委员会是否真的发布了报告。

然而，在此前接受《字林西报》采访时，格罗斯曼博士指出，其组织无意违反中国法律。他表示，所谓的“法庭”仅仅是一个“仲裁委员会”，其遵循的程序甚至得到中国法律的认可和建议。

他坚持认为，如果中国权威部门能证明该“法庭”违反中国法律，相信其组织将充分准备按要求做出相应变更。

举行会议

虽然中国法院官员对此局势未作评论，但司法界相关人士昨日表示，律师公会委员会的报告将受到仔细审查。据信，可能会向重庆的国家当局请示此事的处理方针。

另悉，特别委员会于上周六下午召开会议，格罗斯曼博士和一位持异议的律师A·约维肖夫（A. Jovishoff，音译）先生均出席了会议。约维肖夫先生反对该“法庭”，认为其不符合中国法律。

据报道，在会议上，格罗斯曼博士和约维肖夫先生被要求阐述其观点。在提出报告草案之前，会议还研究并讨论了本地法律界发给该公会的信函。

律师发现

上月，当中国律师蔡菲利普（Philip Tsai，音译）先生提请中国法院和律师公会注意该机构的设立时，“仲裁法庭”的建立才在上海广为人知。

律师公会依据蔡先生的报告，组织了五名成员组成的委员会，对该局势进行了两周多的研究。

除律师公会外，几位犹太难民律师也表达了对该“法庭”的反对。他们指出，难民组织无权使用所谓的强制手段迫使难民服从仲裁。

（批注：US Polk C 10/12）

CHINA PRESS.
NOV 16 1939
26844

Lawyers Here
Say Refugee
Court Illegal

Local German Attorneys
Refute Statement Of
Grossmann

The verbal crossfire centering on
the European refugees' so-called
"Arbitration Court" continued to
flare yesterday when two German
lawyers, in a letter to THE CHINA
PRESS, hotly contested the legality
of the "tribunal."

The letter, signed by Mr. Hans
Ledien and A. Lovishoff, Ger-
man attorneys, sought to refute
the statement made to THE CHINA
PRESS Tuesday by Dr. A. Grossmann,

legal adviser to the Committee for
the Assistance of European Re-
fugees in Shanghai.

Dr. Grossmann, in his statement
in defense of the controversial
"court," asserted that the "tribunal"
is not really a "court" but that it
is merely an ordinary "arbitration
committee." He further sought to
show that the refugee committee
never intended, and has no inten-
tion now, to impair the jurisdiction
of the Chinese courts in Shanghai.

In their letter to THE CHINA PRESS,
which appears on the editorial page
today, Mr. Ledien and Mr. Lovishoff,
who claim to represent 16 of their
colleagues, charged that in est-
ablishing the "court," those re-
sponsible were seeking to exercise
non-existent extra-territorial rights.

The two lawyers claimed that
compulsion has been used in forcing
refugees to avoid the Chinese courts
and to submit their disputes for
arbitration by the "court." The
letter quoted a "literally" transla-
tion of an article of the "court's"
regulations which, according to the
two lawyers, says:

"Non-observation of this prin-
ciple (submission to the arbitration
court) results in the (individual)
concerned forfeiting all privileges,
grants-in-aid and subsidies on the
part of the Committee which, more-
over, may also bring to application
against him further appropriate
measures of punishment."

The two German lawyers further
claimed that in the preamble of the
regulations expressly states that
settling of disputes "through the
state (Chinese) courts are to be
avoided as it is often difficult,
costly and detrimental to prestige."

Mr. Ledien and Mr. Lovishoff em-
phasized in their statement that
they and their colleagues have no
objection whatsoever to the prin-
ciple of voluntary arbitration.
However, they stated, they are
opposed to "compulsion." They
asked for the dissolution of the
so-called "court."

A. S. Pilk
C 16/1
9/10/11

字林西报
1939年11月16日
26844

本地律师
称难民
法庭非法

本地德籍律师
驳斥格罗斯曼
之声明

围绕欧洲难民所谓“仲裁法庭”展开的口舌之争昨日继续升温，两名德籍律师在致《字林西报》的信中，激烈质疑该“法庭”的合法性。

这封由汉斯·莱迪恩（Hans Ledien）和A·洛维肖夫（A. Lovishoff，音译）两位德籍律师签署的信函，旨在驳斥上海欧洲难民救济委员会法律顾问A·格罗斯曼博士周二对《字林西报》发表的声明。

格罗斯曼博士在为这一备受争议的“法庭”辩护的声明中断言，该“法庭”并非真正的“法院”，而只是一个普通的“仲裁委员会”。他还试图表明，难民委员会从未打算、现在也无意损害上海中国法院的管辖权。

莱迪恩先生和洛维肖夫先生在今日刊登于社论版的致《字林西报》信中指出，他们声称代表16位同行，指控那些建立“法庭”的人试图行使不存在的治外法权。

这两位律师声称，有人使用强制手段迫使难民避开中国法院，并将争议提交该“法庭”进行仲裁。信中引用了该“法庭”规章中一条款的“逐字”译文，据两位律师称，该条款规定：

“不遵守此原则（服从仲裁法庭）将导致有关（个人）丧失委员会提供的所有特权、补助金和津贴，此外，委员会还可对其采取进一步的适当惩罚措施。”

这两位德籍律师还声称，规章序言中明确陈述，应避免“通过国家（中国）法院”解决争端，因为这往往困难、昂贵且有损声望。

莱迪恩先生和洛维肖夫先生在声明中强调，他们及其同事对自愿仲裁原则毫无异议。然而，他们表示，他们反对“强制”。他们要求解散所谓的“法庭”。

A. S. Pilk

9/10/11
